item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera wants to find the density of a stone at home in Jaipur. She will measure its mass and its volume, then calculate density.

Which procedure should she follow before using her measurements?

options.A: Read the balance without checking the zero, then pour any amount of water into the measuring cylinder
options.B: Zero the balance before measuring the mass, then read the water level in the measuring cylinder at eye level before and after adding the stone
options.C: Measure the volume first and guess the mass by holding the stone in her hand
options.D: Use the highest mark on the measuring cylinder as the volume of the stone
